description:
Local-first, zero-account Open Source API Client


What's Changed
- Upgrade axum, gRPC crates and tokio-tungstenite; clear npm audit (1049492)
- Update dependencies (fb12f21)
- Add JSONPath and XPath response inspection (2c4e5e5)
- Replace custom schema validation with native jsonschema (af537cd)
- Replace auth-type switches with an AUTH_TYPES registry and drop the import-time AuthManager singleton (072c57c)
- Move the collection composition root into a feature and make its services DOM-free (7018267)
- Share one RequestPipeline between the editor send path and the collection runner (6008bd4)
- Make protocolRegistry the single send/cancel/liveness dispatcher (c61ab5f)
- Break apiHandler import cycles by extracting response view, send controls and request services (81d1189)
- Fix tab-cache seeding on read failure and tidy dead wiring, shadowing and naming (a580141)
